params.note: Delta-based. Only liquid strikes (≥20Δ). European-style, cash-settled.
params.management: 50% profit take / 2× credit stop (Iron Fly: 25% take / 1.5× stop)

config.label: Put Spread 20Δ
config.desc: 45 DTE, sell 20-delta put, buy $50 lower. Bread-and-butter income trade.

config.label: Put Spread 30Δ
config.desc: 45 DTE, sell 30-delta put, buy $50 lower. More premium, more directional risk.

config.label: Put Spread 40Δ
config.desc: 45 DTE, sell 40-delta put, buy $50 lower. Near ATM, high premium.

config.label: Iron Condor 20Δ
config.desc: 45 DTE, sell 20Δ put + 20Δ call, $50 wings. Neutral income.

config.label: Iron Condor 30Δ
config.desc: 45 DTE, sell 30Δ put + 30Δ call, $50 wings. More premium, tighter range.

config.label: Iron Fly 50Δ (ATM)
config.desc: 45 DTE, sell ATM put + ATM call (50Δ), $75 wings. Maximum premium.
